performance_adoption_rule: Report every configured noise/damage tradeoff; no real-audio quality pass threshold or adaptive preset selection from these results.
interpretation_limits: Public real desired-audio clips with injected mathematical hum are not naturally noisy recordings with independent clean references.
Prepared desired reference can contain pre-existing background noise; it is not certified pristine ground truth.
This is a small development study, not a sealed generalization evaluation or perceptual listening test.
Same-frequency wanted content is still confusable; OFF/less depth is manual control, not automatic source protection.
Short audio is never repeated to make the detector activate.
Evaluation-only conversion does not add input format support to the user product.
No audio is played, recorded, uploaded, published or used for identification.
